question:
Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

23 + 84 ÷ 14 × 8 − 3 = 5
solution:
According to the BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

**Option 1 :** ÷ and −

Given:

23 + 84 ÷ 14 × 8 − 3 = 5

After interchange the signs;

23 + 84 - 14 × ***__8 __******__÷ 3__*** = 5

By BODMAS rule

23 + 84 - ***__14 × 2.67__*** = 5

***__23 + 84__*** – 37.34 = 5

***__107 – 37.34__*** = 5
